payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates over string positions, maintains dp array g and accumulator f. When a match of t ends at i, updates f by adding g[start of match]; then g[i] updates as g[i-1]+f. f accumulates total ways.
payload.rationale: Solution uses only a 1-dimensional DP array g and a single accumulator f; state is position index with no second dimension. Computes number of ways to select non-overlapping substrings containing t.
